sentences.en: This is the book that my teacher recommended to me.
sentences.zh: 这是我老师推荐给我的书。

sentences.en: To complete this work, the following working items are recommended.
sentences.zh: 为了完成这项工作，以下的工作项目被建议使用。

sentences.en: I recommend you to set about your business without delay.
sentences.zh: 我建议你尽快开始处理这件事。

senses.zh: 推荐，介绍；劝告；使受欢迎；托付
